dependencies.nasTunnelImage: Keep the currently approved immutable image tag/digest; Dockerfile latest default is not a release pin

contracts.androidRoomMigration: 26 -> 27 -> 28 -> 29; preserves Task, pending writes and Feed state; backward APK/database downgrade requires the coordinated pre-update snapshot.
contracts.mixedOldCoreRestriction: Keep Desktop/Core/MCP/Android on the release commit before adopting new history. Old APK rejects the expanded Feed response and retains its cached posts; headless deployments without feedWriter retain actions pending with an explicit rejection.

activation.taskStart: Independent TASKEN_CORE_AI_TASK_START=1 opt-in; default 0; read-only denied
activation.historyImport: Explicit file preview/adoption or consented Codex/Claude source-folder difference collection; no hook installation. Optional in-app five-minute sync is off by default; no OS autostart.
activation.agentSessions: Today includeAgentSessions=true with mobile:read and mobile:context-read

rollout: Owner authorized Tasken main merge, release and coordinated PC/Android/NAS update on 2026-10-04. Prepare and validate one commit; preserve writer inventory, data, backups, existing credentials/permissions and other NAS apps. Execution receipts and artifact hashes are recorded separately.
